newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Apple Fields to move into property.
newsitem.headline: Apple Fields to move into property.

text.p: Apple Fields Ltd said on Wednesday it would close its orchard operations and immediately restructure into a residential property development company using Christchurch land holdings and other land contracted for that purpose.

The move followed the refusal of a licence from New Zealand's Apple and Pear Marketing Board for Apple Fields to export its total crop in a joint venture with European, U.S. and Asian fruit distributors.
Apple Fields said the impact on its financial position would be positive, as the orchards currently did not reflect their alternate highest value use as lifestyle blocks and residential developments.

"We estimate the net increase in the non-current assets (the orchards') value to recognise their highest value use would be NZ$5.8 million, to be offset to an extent by the need to provide for orchard operating costs and redundancy costs in the 1996/97 year in respect to ceasing orchard operations at $3.7 million, giving a net estimated improvement in shareholders' funds of $2.1 million," it said.
